description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for calendar events, including 'EventRequest' for incoming event data and 'EventResponse' for outgoing event data, along with a conversion function from an 'Event' entity to 'EventResponse'.

classes.name: EventRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating or updating calendar events, including validation annotations for required fields.

classes.name: EventResponse
classes.description: DTO for returning calendar event details in API responses, including event attributes and timestamps.

methods.name: Event.toResponse
methods.description: Extension function converting an 'Event' entity into an 'EventResponse' DTO.
